book.name: Bira Qorontoos
book.title: Kiristoos Yisa Tarjamonnante Kinin Yittsaa Bhawloos Qorontoos Eenana Kinin Thaapoono Birono Warqanno

content: Imbanaanato, inta yekal inin nivon wodanka, Barjosa aachin dhalqinam yena inin dhettsenka, eedi dhalq dheseadettsibee pakalmakkokabe yena giyaatine.
Harrna hambhidianna, inta yekal inin dohon wodanka, Yesus Kiristoosam bish, kidiar masqalindar ziitadhayse kinin diyonam inin giyerra yer ab inta dhesattine hamayse qaabidi i dahade.
Yekal inin dohon wodanka, inta qajebee, kurtumbhebee, gibazbeka i dahade.

Yedi woylamin yenindar qajayno eedi pakalmakkodar daymaka Barjo kantandar konin doadettsi, inin yena giyenbee dhettsenbe Manpas Gazansa kantanam dhayntakane; eediam yidar maasota giidhea pakalmakko dhalq yena giyaatine.
Barjo Yisa Manpasinka Kinin Imayno Pakalmakkono
Ko dahaannaar Barjodar woylamin qajintaka wocchimbhaanana wonin giyenka, pakalmakkoka woda giye; pakalmakkono ogonoar peen ko gayno way peen kodar haymbhaana hayamoysa shidhayna eena gaynotehe.
Wonin giyaynoar Barjosa aachin dhalqin pakalmakkonone; ogonoar wodan kosa birayse Barjo ena woam gobshota kinin ashkoono aachimayse dohoonone.
Peen kosa hayamoynsa dahaana eenasa eedi kala hattear pakalmakkon koam dhesadehe. Ini dhesidi hatte ke hanna, gobshin Imbaa Yesusam ziitayse deesehe.
hamayse Mathaap Gazante thaapadhondettsi, woda koam giye.
Manpas Gazano Barjosa qaabon aachi maatonam shiishima, yer wulam marmarayse dhesa ko dhese. Barjoar yisa aachin dhalqinam Manpas Gazan goynka wona may hayayse ki dhahade.
Ea yinti kidara kisa iinte dohonam eedi hayyear dhesehe; ogodettsi taar Barjo Manpasin goynka daymaka, goyti abka Barjo qaabenam eedi hay ki hannaar dhesea qolehe.
Wodi Barjoyn wona sun imon wulam wonin dhesoadettsi, Barjokala imbhon Manpasinam wo tiyade; peen kogayn manpasinam tiyootone.
Ogonante wodi manpasinngayn manpasinka dahaana eenana woda giye. Wonin giyaynoar Barjosa Manpasinin woam dhettsen upsinkane; eedi pakalmakkoka woam dhettsadhon upsinka giyattone.
Barjosa Manpasin yidar qolma eana Manpasin gayno kina malgimmakko konin maatenna, kidi koam tiyana damehe; goynam kosa Manpasinin eshkenna, may hayayse kidi dhesana damehe.
Barjosa Manpasinin dahaa ea yer wulam marmarayse dhesa ki dhese; kiam eedi hayyear marmarayse dhesehe.
hamayse thaapadhondettsine. Kiristoossa qaabono wosa iinte daane.
